From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Exec Suite: Attendee Flow, Network & AV Plan for Dec 12 Workshop

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for hosting us at Acme HQ on Dec 12. We want to lock down the meeting-room selection, attendee flow, and the AV/network requirements so our teams can finalize travel and vendor bookings. High-level asks below; please confirm what you can provide and point us to the site contact (name + cell).

1) Room selection and capacity
- Prefer Executive Suite Level 3: two adjacent rooms (Room A + Room B) that can be opened to form a single 80-person workshop footprint. If not possible, specify alternative adjacent rooms and capacities.
- Need breakout area for 3 small groups (30–45 minute sessions) with moveable tables.

2) AV & connectivity (critical)
- Dedicated VLAN for Redwood demo traffic (we will provide public IPs but need hardwired, 2x1Gb ethernet endpoints in the main mix-lane).
- Bridge: primary Teams/SIP bridge (Acme-managed) + SyncStream hardware encoder as an outbound fallback. Vendor will need multicast off.
- Power: 2 dedicated 20A circuits near the AV rack location; UPS space for encoder/bridge. Please confirm nearest power panels.
- Microphones: PoE support for boundary mics or tabletop mics; we plan for 8 wireless lavs for panel.

3) Noise/adjacency concerns
- Are there construction zones or HVAC noise on Level 3 after 3pm? Any known events in nearby spaces?

4) Logistics & on-site contacts
- Onsite contact for vendor load-in and after-hours access (name/cell).
- Dock/load-in window we should use (truck height limits?).

Attachments: we will send our AV spec sheet and travel roster once we have confirmation on the rooms.

Goal: finalize rooms and network by EOD Thu (Dec 3) so we can buy airfare and book SyncStream.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec Suite: Attendee Flow, Network & AV Plan for Dec 12 Workshop

Rishi —

Appreciate the detail. Quick responses below and I’ve looped in Jason (Facilities) to confirm power/dock details.

1) Rooms: Level 3 Executive Suite A+B can be combined to seat ~85 with our movable partition removed. Breakout area available in the lounge adjacent to Room B (we'll reserve).

2) Network/AV:
- We can provision two hardwired 1Gb ports to a guest VLAN; however, external public IPs require our security team sign-off. Jason, can you expedite?
- We run a Cisco-based SIP trunk for Teams conferencing. We can put the Redwood bridge behind the Acme SBC; SyncStream is OK as a fallback but they must register through Jason’s team.
- Two dedicated 20A outlets available in the AV closet next to Room A. UPS is onsite but limited — if you bring a small rack UPS (1U) that’s preferred.

3) Noise: Our HVAC has a compressor cycle that spikes around 3:30–4:00pm on weekdays. We can request reduced cycling for the day of the workshop but need 48hrs notice.

4) Logistics:
- Site contact: Jason Wu, Facilities Manager — +1 (415) 555-2233.
- Loading bay height: 12ft clearance, dock available 07:00–18:00 weekdays.

I attached the Level 3 floorplan (see acme-floorplan-level3.pdf). Let me know if you need measured distances for AV rack placement.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Grant
Product Partnerships, Acme Corp
